rounds.text: The evidence clearly indicates that Info Edge (India) Ltd (NAUKRI) is being underappreciated in terms of its intrinsic value and potential for growth. [E45] highlights a discounted cash flow model suggesting an intrinsic value of Rs 3,479 per share, which leaves a margin of safety of 64.1%. This implies that the stock's current market price of Rs 1,248 is significantly undervalued based on fundamental analysis. [E56] further supports this by stating that profit growth has outpaced the stock price over the past five years, indicating potential for future value appreciation despite recent performance. Given these strong indicators, it is evident that Info Edge (India) Ltd (NAUKRI) deserves a higher valuation and should be considered as potentially undervalued in the market.

[E1] (bear) Trades at a P/E of 65.9 against a sector benchmark of 41.58x implies that Info Edge (India) Ltd is trading significantly above its peers in terms of earnings per share, suggesting inflated valuations. [E7] (bull) P/B of 2.13x against a sector benchmark of 7.05x indicates that the stock is undervalued relative to its book value compared to other companies in the sector, which could be seen as a positive indicator for potential upside. [E46] (bull) A discounted cash flow puts intrinsic value at Rs 3479 per share against a market price of Rs 1248. This suggests that the stock is trading below its intrinsic value, implying a margin of safety and potentially undervalued. [E56] (neutral) FUNDAMENTALS-LED — Profit grew 34% vs price 4% (5Y) — fundamentals outpacing the stock; potentially undervalued. This suggests that despite the current market valuation, the company's underlying financial performance is strong and could justify a higher valuation. [E72] (neutral) Bias check — Valuation blind-spot: Rich valuation — P/E 66, P/B 2.3. A market-beating chart doesn't make a rich entry safe; the price already discounts a lot of the good news. This implies that while the company is performing well financially, its current high valuations could be seen as risky and potentially overvalued. Conceded: [E4] (neutral) Dividend yield is 0.67%. A low dividend yield does not provide any direct evidence for or against the valuation of the stock and thus carries no weight in this argument.
